pages.title: Checkout API — Developer Guide
pages.content_text: The Checkout API creates and authorizes customer orders. It integrates with the Risk Decision API for fraud prevention and the Payment Authorization API for tokenized payments. All requests require OAuth 2.0 bearer authentication. Rate limit: 500 requests per minute. The POST /orders endpoint accepts an order payload and returns the authorization result with decision evidence. Timeout budget for the risk call is 250ms with one bounded retry.

pages.title: Risk Decision API — Integration Guide
pages.content_text: The Risk Decision API v2 evaluates order risk using behavioral signals, account history, and device fingerprinting. It returns a score (0-100), an approve/review decision, and an array of contributing factors. The API does not receive or store card data. Consumers should implement a timeout fallback — the recommended budget is 250ms. Decision explanations are available via GET /v2/decisions/{id}/explain.

pages.title: Checkout Service Status
pages.content_text: Checkout API: Operational. Last incident: INC0071042 on 2026-10-01 — checkout latency spike after risk service release. Duration: 52 minutes. Resolution: bounded fallback deployed via emergency change CHG0081088. Current uptime: 99.97% (30-day rolling). SLO target: 99.9%.
